name: カンバンの状態列
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Generate ONE Lighthouse catalog component LH09-0006 カンバンの状態列, a single compact Todo column with header and exactly TWO taskcards.
Hierarchy: ORIGINAL image1 controls icon glyphs, geometry, proportions, opticalstroke, alignment, spacing, controlanatomy and missingdetail. Mock image2 is SECONDARY Japanese content/layout; do not copy roughicons or repeated incorrectmetadata. Image3 is official white rounded surfaces/softshadow only, no buscontent.
Topheader: small thin empty statuscircle, Japanese「未着手」, count「2 / 3」close afterlabel as original, right tiny actualround-three-dotellipsis andthinplus.
Card1: top「作業-12」and original tiny dottedcircleassignee at right. Nextline empty neutralstatuscircle and Japanese regular title「共有する要約を作成する」. Nextrow original white circular prioritybutton with3ascendingbars, whiteoutlined pill with amberdot「文書」. Bottom「作成日 3月31日」.
Card2: restore ORIGINAL differingmetadata, not repeatedmock. Top「作業-10」and dottedcircleassignee. Nextline empty neutralstatuscircle and Japanese regular title「成功の基準を決める」. Nextrow original circularprioritybars, whiteoutlined due-datepill withsmall slatecalendar「4月8日」, whiteoutlined categorypill withindigodot「分析」, whiteoutlined categorypill withlavenderdot「機能」. Bottom「作成日 3月31日」.
Original distinct categorydots serve coherent groups: amberfor文書, mutedindigo for分析, mutedlavender for機能. Retain category distinctions only on tiny dots. Utilityglyphs allslate #526173, empty statuses neutral, no random multicoloricons. No primaryfilledaction exists; no inventedgreenbutton.
Whole canvas #FFFFFF, two roundedwhitecards, fine neutralborders, subtle softdownwardshadow, no broadgray/mintcolumnfill, no wrappercard. Compact approx330x340 logicalpixel arrangement, narrow cardgap, usable proportions. Match ORIGINAL refined icon strokes/enclosures and metadata positions; no oversizedsunpersonicons.
Locked Japanese Meiryo Regular14/24 body, Regular12/16metadata, zero tracking; labels regular notbold. No addedheading, metrics, thirdcard or omittedcontrols. Clear exact Japanese andnumerals, no clipping. Tight singlecomponent framing. Static rastercandidate.
reviewNotes: 原画像・個別切抜き・通常/390幅モックを実見。二枚目の作業10/4月8日/分析/機能を原画像から復元、日本語と全制御を確認。分類の意味を持つ小点のみ琥珀/藍/薄紫を保持し補助はスレート。未着手見出しが指定Regularより太いため要修正。白面と細境界、内容欠落や切れ無し。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
